## Problem

What is wrong or missing, who hits it, and a concrete trigger (input, command, or diagnostic). Not a restatement of the diff.

## Proposed change

What the PR does and why that fixes the problem. Name the behavior that changes, not every file.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches, including doing nothing, and why each was rejected.

## Testing

Each new or changed test by name and what it pins, then commands run with results. State what was not run and why.

<!-- Keep below only where they apply: -->
- Documentation: canonical rules/examples and regenerated references.
- Compatibility: public API, diagnostic, manifest, or artifact changes; migration.
